meta.name: Sleeping Dog
meta.description: A former detective now living on the streets searches for the truth after a new death raises unnerving doubts about a supposedly settled murder case.

videos.title: Startled
videos.overview: A prisoner's death sparks questions about a closed murder case, spurring former detective Mike Atlas and prosecutor Jule Andergast to seek answers.

videos.title: Surprise!
videos.overview: Tom investigates an unsettling new murder while Jule and Mike combine two sets of puzzle pieces. Trying to reach Mike, Joachim approaches Tinka.

videos.title: Connecting
videos.overview: A desperate maneuver puts one of Mike's loved ones in harm's way. Jule and Mike face skepticism in their hunt for the truth about Judge Herres' death.

videos.title: Chez Amis
videos.overview: Reeling from a horrific shock, Jule confides in a friend and makes a key connection. Luka finds himself under suspicion. Britney imagines a new life.

videos.title: Digging Deep
videos.overview: Tom and Jule challenge Corinna's judgment. A sudden change pushes Mike to consider his future, while his investigation stirs up ghosts from the past.

videos.title: Confessions
videos.overview: A shocking confession points Mike and Jule toward the truth, but will there be enough time to stop a single-minded killer from claiming another victim?
